page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Two paragraphs open with numbered sections (VIII, IX), each with a left marginal note. A short centred paragraph and a right-aligned reference "Cap.5." sit at the foot.

main_text.p: tur. Hi sunt veluti viatores, qui multa habent hospitia, amicitias nullas. Hi duos infectantur lepores, neutrum capiunt. Hi nusquam sunt, dum ubique sunt. Hi contra naturam agunt, quae abhorret ab infinito. Hi similimi sunt iis, qui multa edunt, sed non concoquunt. Optandum autem esset, ut hodierno die alerentur in scholis praecones, qui juventuti insufurrarent illud πολυδρύλλιον[?], HOCAGES; quod Romanus praeco in Capitolio acclamabat populo sacris operaturo.

Nimia diligentia.VIII. Nimia & immoderata studia. Hic vero est hostis omnium deterrimus. Nimirum ingenii vigor & acrimonia atteritur, exhauritur nimiis vi-giliis. Nam spiritus vitales in corde, & animales in cerebro fatigantur nimium quantum vigiliis & studiis. Immane quantum est facinus corporis proprii esse carnificem! Immoderatis vigiliis ac praepropero studiis emaciare quantum scelus?

Mutatio præceptorum.IX. Mutatio præceptorum. Videte mihi etiam hunc hostem, ordine quidem postremum, sed vi facile principem. Præcepta mutare, præceptores mutare, id vero egregie facit ad eruditionis cornucopiæ comparandum. Scilicet. Hodie quid crebrius! Is, ut monet majorum gentium Orator, qui cupit in aliquo excellere, unius ingenio familiariter applicare se debet. Oportet igitur certis præceptis veluti innutriri, oportet ad pedes alicujus præceptoris eum perdiu educari & edoceri, qui cupit fundamenta jacere.
Atq; hæc sunt illa impedimenta, per quæ fiat, quo minus hodie maxima studiosorum pars progrediatur, quodq; in medio etiam cursu deficiant.

page.notes: Printed "Cap.5." at the lower right is treated as the catchword. The Greek word after "illud" is uncertain: it is read as πολυδρύλλιον but the scan is not clear. "HOCAGES;" is printed with letter spacing and is underlined. The strikethrough over "non concoquunt" and the underlines in the text are not reproduced as markup. The "q;" abbreviations in "Atq;" and "quodq;" are read from a small mark and may be wrong. The note marker for the IX note is a short bracket mark, and the note is transcribed as printed. The phrase "vi-giliis" keeps the printed hyphen.
